properties.evidence: Corroboration, and together they are the strongest evidence yet for the open question of how an agent comes to use reflow2's disciplines unprompted. Both record a failure that a written, correct, ALREADY-READ discipline did not prevent, and that a person caught instead of a mechanism: one an overwrite warning read hours before it was ignored, the other four sound measurements answering the wrong population. Neither is a knowledge gap — in both cases the right rule was known and available at the moment it was needed.
